notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plates come in white, black or turquoise; the turquoise ones exist only here.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Script has a continuous line over every word, like Devanagari but with many triangular letter shapes; also used in eastern India.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 3 has three cars: one with red mirrors and bars, a classic white one, and a striped white one that resembles one in Cambodia.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 4 uses a black car and a white car, and the footage often has a smoky look.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Some poor-quality "shitcam" coverage exists in black and white; a big round blur may hide the car colour.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Rickshaws are everywhere, especially green auto-rickshaws.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Black-and-white striped signposts are common; Sri Lanka, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Malaysia have them too.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Water bodies and farm fields often sit beside the road, with roadside trees whose trunks have white paint at the base.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Red-and-white concrete bollards appear nationwide, round or sometimes square.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Tin roofs are common, as in many humid South and Southeast Asian countries.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The west mostly has hip roofs of sheet metal.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The east has sheet metal roofs with a triangular window below the ridge, exclusive in Sylhet.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Rice growth stage, from short green to tall yellow to harvested, varies by division in Generation 4 and helps regionguessing.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The country is nearly all flat, but the far southeast has tall forested hills.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Growing jute on Street View is found almost only in Rangpur.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Tea is grown in the highlands of the south of Sylhet.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Yellow-flowering canola fields are very common in the capital division north of the Padma River.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Thin drooping beach sheoak trees are found on the coast of the Teknaf peninsula and near Noakhali.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: The low-quality shitcam coverage is only found in and around the capital.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: In Sylhet and Barishal cities, a guard standing by the car is sometimes visible in Generation 3.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A trekker with red mirrors is unique to Nijhum Dwip island.
